mapper.sql: id, space_id, sender_id,receiver_id, space_type, title, delete_flag,created_by, created_dt, updated_by, updated_dt

if.test: deleteFlag != null and id == null and ids == null

mapper.select: select cs.id, cs.space_id, cs.sender_id, cs.receiver_id, cs.space_type, cs.title, cs.delete_flag, cs.created_by, cs.created_dt, cs.updated_by, cs.updated_dt, (select m.message from chat_msg m where m.space_id = cs.space_id and m.delete_flag = 1 order by m.id desc limit 1) as last_message, (select m.created_dt from chat_msg m where m.space_id = cs.space_id and m.delete_flag = 1 order by m.id desc limit 1) as last_time from chat_space cs where cs.space_type = #{spaceType} and cs.sender_id = #{senderId} and cs.delete_flag = 1 order by cs.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into chat_space (space_id, sender_id,receiver_id, space_type, title, delete_flag,created_by, created_dt, updated_by, updated_dt) values (#{spaceId}, #{senderId}, #{receiverId}, IFNULL(#{spaceType}, 1), #{title}, 1, #{createdBy} , #{createdDt}, #{updatedBy}, #{updatedDt})
mapper.update: update chat_space set title = #{title}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_dt = now() where space_id = #{spaceId} and (title is null or title = '')
